user.title: AutiPlanner (hosted)
user.description: Connect to an AutiPlanner server. On Home Assistant OS, install the AutiPlanner (hosted) app from Settings > Apps and press Start first, because HACS installs only this integration, not the server. The default address is the app's.

server_unreachable.title: AutiPlanner server is unreachable
server_unreachable.description: Home Assistant cannot reach the AutiPlanner server at {url}. If you run it as a Home Assistant app, open Settings > Apps, install **AutiPlanner (hosted)** if it is not already there, and press **Start**. Installing the integration through HACS does not install or start the app. If you run the server elsewhere, check that it is running and that the address is correct.
